title: WordPress pictures Tracy placed read back as the site holds them, at the path the page prints
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A picture slot's current value is the plugin's slots value, with imageSlots kept as the demo sample; a picture line ordered at images/tracy-content/<sha>.<ext> is reported at wp-content/uploads/tracy-content/<sha>.<ext> on WordPress only.

tests: the plugin inspect is read as a list of slots, pictures typed, by the write step and the site check alike
a picture line is reported at the path WordPress prints it, so the site check finds what was written
